goal: Fix every finding in REPORT.md; do not mark complete until all original repair gates are verified.

findings.title: Advertised interleaved 80 ksym/s Meteor transport is missing
findings.change: Implement explicit shared OQPSK72/NRZ-M and OQPSK80/interleaved NRZ-M profiles, streaming 0x27 marker acquisition and 36-branch delayed-bit transport before Viterbi. Carry missing-history flags through the permutation, reset on marker-phase loss, merge equivalent frame observations, and expose the actual mission selection in offline decoding. Software checks pass; independent off-air 80k CADU/image validation remains outstanding. Daemon channels now select the same complete profiles; sampling and product lifecycles are enforced under S11. Only the independent off-air 80k comparison remains unverified for this finding.
regressions: Explicit Oqpsk72 public off-air slice: 175 byte-identical reference CADUs.
findings.original_repair_gate: Add explicit mission/transport profiles. Decode marker-bearing interleaved symbols with streaming state and validate the resulting CADUs against an independently decoded 80k recording. Also validate the separate 72k NRZ-M profile. Compare packet bytes and images, not just lock flags.

findings.title: OQPSK carrier/timing recovery depends on absolute RF phase
findings.change: Track the carrier on matched complex samples before branch projection/deskew, use sample-clock-scaled second-order loop gains, and continuously decode both half-symbol stagger directions through 16 ambiguity hypotheses. Keep erasure observations per stagger pairing. Integrate bounded Gardner timing period to track continuous clock-rate error through the long interleaver startup.
regressions: Independent analytical RRC/libfec corpus: full 0..345-degree sweep in 15-degree steps, both stagger directions, 640 kS/s and 80 ksym/s; byte-identical three-payload recovery across both input partitions.
Independent fractional 25.6-sample/symbol and 72k/four-sample cases with +/-1 kHz carrier offset and +/-150 ppm clock drift: every payload equal; all 60 cases pass at chunk sizes 997 and 16384.
Public Meteor-M2-4 off-air slice at 180..200 seconds: 175 corrected CADUs match independent reference byte-for-byte; zero additional CADUs.
Unchanged audit_logic: every original phase probe returns 12 valid RS codewords; 180-degree phase slip matches 24-codeword clean control; zero-input lock remains false.

Long analytical interleaved 80k IQ with +70 ppm clock drift: both stagger directions recover exactly three identical payloads in two chunk sizes; original 60-case corpus and public 72k slice still pass.
findings.original_repair_gate: Test a full phase sweep with pulse-shaped independent OQPSK, both stagger orientations, frequency offset, fractional sampling and clock drift. Correct carrier/timing recovery in a way valid for staggered branches. Require payload equality across phases.

findings.title: Viterbi metrics saturate and permanently kill the decoder
findings.change: Normalize finite path metrics and retain odd coded bits across chunks.
regressions: 8,192,000-noise-step audit probe: subsequent clean comparison has zero errors.
findings.original_repair_gate: Normalize finite metrics periodically and retain valid traceback ordering. Require arbitrarily long noisy/weak intervals to recover a subsequent known clean payload without restarting the app. Compare fresh and aged decoders and test multiple chunk partitions.

findings.title: First successful ambiguity lane is selected forever
findings.change: Continuously advance every ambiguity hypothesis, merge located candidates chronologically, suppress equivalent observations by bit position, reject frames containing missing-energy decisions, and expire current frame lock after two CADUs without validation.
regressions: tests::hypotheses_reacquire_polarity_conjugation_and_axis_changes_in_stream_order (plain and NRZ-M, byte-identical payloads across partitions)
audit_logic: 180-degree slip recovers 24 RS codewords, identical to clean six-frame control
findings.original_repair_gate: Expire lane selection on a defined loss/BER criterion and rebuild or continuously advance alternative hypotheses. Test phase slips, fades, polarity/conjugation changes and valid later frames without an external reset. Publish current frame synchronization, not historical selection.

findings.title: Frame search skips an earlier valid marker in favor of a later cleaner one
findings.change: Select admissible markers chronologically; validate RS before consuming a candidate boundary.
findings.original_repair_gate: Search in chronological order with frame/RS validation, or retain candidates until rejected. Require identical recovered frame sequences across chunk partitions containing imperfect and perfect markers, false payload markers and truncated suffixes.

findings.title: Space-packet headers split across transfer frames are discarded
findings.change: Retain incomplete primary headers and bodies across packet zones and idle-only frames.
findings.original_repair_gate: Keep partial primary headers per virtual channel until the length field is available, then continue the packet body. Test every split position, multiple continuations, frame gaps, idle-only frames and subsequent new-header pointers. Preserve the CCSDS rule that idle-only frames can occur during a fragmented packet.

findings.title: Same-APID packets on different virtual channels overwrite each other
findings.change: Own in-progress bytes by virtual channel, including independent gap handling.
findings.original_repair_gate: Own pending packet bytes by VCID, or by a full validated channel identity, and deliver APID only after reassembly. Require independent results and gap handling for interleaved channels sharing APIDs.

findings.title: Image origin is the satellite's sequence zero rather than the received pass
findings.change: Retain sparse segments on a shared unwrapped sequence/time clock, align channel-cycle phases, crop all channels to common received pass bounds, and cap relative span. Use CDS-time anchors to survive multiple wraps, long gaps, midnight and old reordered packets.
regressions: Independent full-pass CDS/Pillow oracle: 28,473 segments; all 25,890,816 pixels match within one level across three aligned 1568x5504 channels.
findings.original_repair_gate: Retain absolute sequence/time identities for placement but render relative to the received pass bounds. Track valid segments separately from allocated height. Verify late starts, rollover, missing packets, reordering and cross-channel row alignment with an independently decoded pass.

findings.title: JPEG dequantization retains an extra half-unit in every table entry
findings.change: Use the mission integer quantization rule before dequantization.
regressions: Independent off-air full-pass libjpeg comparison covers quality 36..100 with exact mission integer DQT values: maximum pixel error 1.
findings.original_repair_gate: Use the mission's integer quantization convention. Test nonzero DC/AC, quality values on both scale branches, run-length/ZRL/EOB cases and orientation against independent JPEG vectors. Retain a stated pixel-rounding tolerance for differing IDCT implementations.

findings.title: Lock and decoded-line diagnostics can report success without current reception
findings.change: Require energized matched symbols and 64 sustained coherent loop observations for carrier lock; expire frame lock after two missing CADUs. Count unique segments and complete scanlines independently of raster height. Publish at quarter-second symbol cadence and immediately on lock transitions at caller chunk boundaries.
regressions: Independent public pass: 28,473 unique segments and 16,192 complete scanlines; holes and incomplete rows do not count as complete lines.
findings.original_repair_gate: Gate carrier lock on energy/SNR and sustained valid loop behavior; expire frame lock on recent validation; count actual valid scanlines/segments separately from output extent. Test noise, silence, stale lock and sparse images with explicit time/observation bounds.

findings.title: Daemon LRPT accepts unusable sampling and cannot select the 72k profile
findings.change: Require an explicit shared Meteor transport profile in ChannelSpec and TelemetryConfig; validate occupied bandwidth and the actual integer-decimated sample rate before allocation and retuning. Carry a stable source product session through ingestion/channelization, independent of gap epochs. Preserve received images/counts across gaps; retire them on source session, RF retune or explicit StartTelemetryProduct. Tag every preview with product_id, announce boundaries and clear retired APID images in GUI. Bump binary protocol to 11 and document the 36-byte raw telemetry header.
regressions: pipelines::telemetry::tests::received_images_survive_gap_epochs_but_retire_on_real_product_boundaries (three independently generated image CADUs, nonempty pixels and RS counters)
findings.original_repair_gate: Make transport/symbol rate explicit in telemetry configuration, enforce the demodulator's real sampling and occupied-band requirements, and distinguish capture gaps from new satellite/product sessions. Reject unsupported subscriptions before allocating threads.

findings.title: Listen-tab CS8 replay interprets signed bytes as unsigned IQ
findings.change: Convert CS8 signed components to CU8 before byte publication.
findings.original_repair_gate: Carry an explicit sample format through capture or convert CS8 before CU8 publication. Compare spectra and demodulated payload/audio for equivalent CU8, CS8 and CF32 files at multiple amplitudes and across zero crossings.

findings.title: Local float replay discards CF32 dynamic range before radio DSP
findings.change: Keep normalized native CF32 samples in capture blocks and radio DSP; preserve CF32 export precision. Explicitly label the optional CU8 compatibility export and record its conversion in metadata.
findings.original_repair_gate: Preserve native floating-point IQ through the local data plane, with format/unit metadata, or explicitly limit float replay to an 8-bit compatibility mode. Validate sub-byte amplitudes and headroom against a float reference, not an 8-bit encoder round trip.

findings.title: Daemon narrow-channel decimation aliases strong adjacent signals
findings.change: Replace the fixed 63-tap/clamped-cutoff decimator with bounded half-band stages and a phase-selected Blackman-Harris FIR designed from actual output rate. Specify <=0.02 dB passband error through 0.4 Fsout and >=80 dB rejection from 0.5 Fsout. Preserve exact source-grid counts, rational phase, chunks and reset alignment, including prime/large decimation.
regressions: streamed_filters_reject_aliases_and_strong_mixtures_including_interpolated_prime_phases: D=2/10/163/4093; wanted, band edge, Nyquist, folding tones and four strong adjacent interferers.
rational_output_phases_follow_the_source_clock_with_constant_filter_delay: analytic complex tone phase/amplitude against exact physical group delay, both frequency signs through passband edge.
staged_and_prime_decimations_preserve_counts_partitions_and_reset_alignment: D=1/2/7/10/17/160/163/4093; bit-identical output under chunks 1/37/997; aligned reset counts.
extreme_decimation_does_not_allocate_a_source_rate_sized_fir: D=2048003 and u32::MAX; final coefficients below 1 MiB.
Existing source-clock, gap, retune, packet and product regressions pass in the full workspace suite.

Production SampleBus/DDC sweep: 622 frequencies across 15 geometries, minimum rejection 111.150040 dB, maximum passband error 0.000041 dB, four-interferer mixture relative error <=0.000004545. See repair-channelizer-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Design filtering from actual passband, transition width and stopband rejection; use staged/polyphase decimation where needed. Sweep frequencies and source rates, and assert the rejection requirement before downsampling. Test adjacent-channel mixtures, not only wanted tones.

findings.title: Daemon playback downsamples mono PCM without an anti-alias filter
findings.change: Replace linear interpolation of unfiltered mono PCM with a streaming phase-selected Blackman-Harris FIR. Low-pass before rate conversion with a declared passband/transition and >=80 dB rejection. Use bounded integer phase with the exact rational capture rate and retire history at invalid geometry, rate changes or frame gaps; preserve output cadence and post-filter gain.
regressions: passband_phase_and_stopband_rejection_hold_at_production_playback_rates: independent analytic sine phase/amplitude and stop tones at destination Nyquist, its edge and MPX frequencies.

real_daemon_wfm_mpx_and_strong_mixtures_do_not_alias_into_playback: real SampleBus -> AudioPipeline -> AudioFrame -> playback conversion, both destination rates, four input rates; identical full/split outputs and wanted-versus-MPX mixtures.
real_daemon_am_and_nfm_destination_rate_conversion_rejects_out_of_band_audio: 49 kHz producer audio cannot fold into 4.9/1 kHz playback.

fractional_capture_rate_controls_playback_phase_and_arbitrary_frame_splits: 204800.3 S/s physical input clock with integer display rate 204800, exact output counts and independently predicted 17 kHz phase.
mixed_stream_audio_clock_and_sequence_gaps_reset_interpolation: existing epoch/index/sequence/channel/origin/gap regression now verifies FIR history retirement.
122 production PCM measurements: minimum rejection 112.350624 dB; 32 real WFM MPX cases: minimum rejection 115.348143 dB. See repair-playback-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Low-pass to the destination audio passband before decimation, using a streaming rational-rate converter with known rejection. Test real demodulator output, stereo/RDS-range MPX components, source rates, 44.1/48 kHz output and arbitrary frame splits.

findings.title: Local FM loudness changes with RF sample rate and RF decimation
findings.change: Normalize local NFM/WFM audio and taps to physical 5 kHz/75 kHz deviation at the actual RF/IF discriminator clock. Share the mono/stereo frequency meter, ignore initial phase/carrier offset and retire readings at capture/clock resets. Preserve clean IF modulation, correct sample-interval averaging and use linear-phase RF decimation so changing source rate, RF decimation, IF presets or stereo does not change calibrated gain.
regressions: 216 independent analytical tone cases at three source rates, RF factors 1/2/4, all IF presets, NFM/WFM mono/stereo fallback and 44.1/48 kHz playback: <=0.046177 dB gain error, <0.84% deviation error, pitch/count gates pass.
12 independent continuous stereo-MPX cases: <=0.104252 dB L/R gain error, <2.10% deviation error; 24 downmix comparisons <=0.007001 dB; mono/stereo deviation readings exactly equal.
All 75 demodulator tests and full workspace suite pass; default build, all-target Clippy with warnings denied, formatting and AST refresh pass. See repair-fm-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Define a physical deviation-to-audio scale and normalize with the actual discriminator clock. Require constant gain, pitch and reported deviation across source rates, RF decimation, IF noise reduction and mono/stereo paths.

findings.title: USB/LSB power squelch measures a symmetric band instead of the selected sideband
findings.change: Share nominal RF passband geometry between the demodulator, selected-channel carrier-peak measurement and scanner/spectrum selection, including DSB side selection. USB and LSB reject opposite-sideband peaks while retaining weak wanted carriers in stronger mixtures.
regressions: 810 wanted/opposite/mixed SSB cases across rates, widths and VFO offsets; 12 actual native squelch/recording-monitor cases and 12 scanner-consumer cases; active original audit_ssb_power_meter_passband. See repair-power-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Share the demodulator's actual passband geometry with power measurement. Test wanted and opposite tones throughout both SSB sidebands, combined signals, VFO offsets and recording/scanning consumers.

findings.title: Narrow power measurements can return silence because no FFT bin fits
findings.change: Use adaptive complete-window FFT observations with Blackman-Harris sidelobe control, fractional-peak frequency inference and calibrated scalloping correction after bounded antialias downconversion. Explicitly document carrier peak amplitude in dBFS rather than integrated RF power, and retire incomplete/history observations on context changes.
regressions: Every integer CW width 50..500 Hz (451 cases), 72 edge/fractional-clock cases at 8 kS/s through 20 MS/s, arbitrary chunks/whole-stream equality and resets, complete-window counting, invalid geometry; active original half-old-bin carrier probe with acquisition length extended to a complete adaptive observation. See repair-power-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Measure a filtered/time-domain channel or account for partial bins with suitable resolution and leakage control. Validate off-bin carriers at every supported narrow width, and state whether the metric is peak-bin amplitude or integrated RF power.

findings.title: Old capture generations are accepted under a new receiver session's controls
findings.change: Reject stale capture generations before DSP/publication, without sending errors to new-session audio recorders. Retire epoch and radio snapshot state at the processed generation boundary, even when the new block is rejected under stale controls.
findings.original_repair_gate: Reject blocks that do not belong to the active requested capture generation before demodulation/publication. Account for the rejected tail separately. Test rapid same-frequency restarts, format/source changes and simultaneous recorder/audio reopening.

findings.title: AM audio aliases when the selected RF band exceeds output audio Nyquist
findings.change: Filter full-rate detected AM/SSB/DSB/CW audio before converting to the device clock; run CW beat mixing before conversion and audio controls at the device rate. Preserve unclipped envelope headroom, exact capture duration through partial RF strides, and coherent constructor clocks.
regressions: Six focused regressions cover 12 mode/RF-clock cases, 8k/16k/44.1k/48k audio, nonlinear envelope harmonics, CW beat aliases, unclipped carrier headroom, physical notch frequency, tiny chunks, resets and float-only native partial strides. Maximum 6k-to-2k alias is 0.0000032077 against the unchanged 0.00002 limit.

All 64 unique affected tests pass, including the original unchanged DC regression, 16 native consumers and five default FM/WFM/worker regressions. GUI build, all-target Clippy with warnings denied, formatting and AST graph refresh pass under 10% of one CPU. See repair-detected-antialias-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Low-pass the detected envelope before subsampling, with cutoff tied to the destination/effective output rate. Apply the same requirement to product/SSB routes where configured passbands can exceed audio Nyquist. Test rate/bandwidth combinations and nonlinear envelope harmonics.

findings.title: RAW output has the wrong channel count and timebase for playback/WAV
findings.change: Define local RAW as filtered/resampled stereo I/Q at the selected audio clock, carry two channels through native playback and WAV headers/metadata, and preserve exact root-capture duration despite fractional RF clocks, chunk boundaries and partial RF strides. Keep full-band IQ export at RF rate.
regressions: Eight focused regressions: 45 clock/partition cases, 27 RF-stride partition cases, six independent I/Q amplitude/alias checks and three one-second native playback/WAV cases including 64x RF decimation with 384k audio. Equal clocks preserve I/Q exactly without new delay.

All 102 unique affected tests pass, including the unchanged RF impulse regression, native consumers, WAV recording, recorder, radio channel selection and audio output. GUI default build, all-target Clippy, formatting and AST graph refresh pass at 20% of one CPU. See repair-raw-audio-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Define RAW semantics explicitly: properly resampled stereo I/Q audio, an RF-rate IQ export, or an analysis-only mode. Carry correct channels/rate through playback and recording. Require duration and sample-count equality for each supported source clock.

findings.title: Reset disables the configured audio high-pass until coefficients are recomputed
findings.change: Retain configured HPF coefficients when resetting delay state.
findings.original_repair_gate: Reset state without erasing configured coefficients, or recompute immediately after reset. Require a reset processor to match a freshly configured processor with every advanced filter active, including the first block after a capture gap.

findings.title: Daemon SSB rejection degrades sharply at the actual GUI channel rate
findings.change: Select USB/LSB with a 36th-order complex Butterworth response specified in Hz at the exact channel clock. Restore the mixer translation before real projection to retain voice pitch. The six-clock, whole-voice-band sweep, stronger opposite-signal mixtures and reset/chunk regressions pass alongside all 18 existing audio regressions, default daemon build, all-target Clippy, formatting and AST graph refresh.
findings.original_repair_gate: Bring SSB to a suitable intermediate rate with anti-alias filtering or scale the filter design to a defined transition/rejection. Sweep the entire voice passband at actual production rates for both sidebands and mixed adjacent signals.

findings.title: Automatic recording/monitoring has an undocumented -90 dB cutoff and no daemon power feed
findings.change: Use explicit Power/enabled state for every threshold. Consume current native observations or acknowledged, fresh, tagged daemon raw spectrum measurements independently of display/tab rendering. Count only successful local starts or current-session daemon active acknowledgements, preserving recording transitions and guarding pending/failed requests.
regressions: Ten focused regressions cover 202 thresholds/source cases, observation expiry/context resets, gain and scanner boundaries, local file-open failure and exact final bytes, daemon acknowledgements/timeout/cancelled/closed-queue cases and preserved queue phases.
All 62 unique affected tests pass; GUI default build, all-target Clippy, formatting and AST graph refresh pass with a strict 20%-of-one-core limit. See repair-trigger-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Use explicit enabled/mode state instead of a magic threshold sentinel. Route acknowledged, fresh daemon RF measurements when supported or disable the feature with a clear reason. Increment recording count only after successful start. Test the full threshold range and both sources.

findings.title: Rejected hardware tuning changes capture metadata anyway
findings.change: Commit backend caches only after accepted calls. Recover failures by reopening the source at the last verified frequency/rate and original gain request/mode; retire acquisition if restoration fails. Preserve verified terminal status and reset clocks after recovery.
findings.original_repair_gate: Commit applied settings only after successful hardware calls; recover/read back actual state after partial failures. Do not publish normal samples with unverified geometry. Test mutation-before-error sources, not just mocks whose rejecting setters preserve state automatically.

findings.title: HackRF callback overflow is silently stitched into continuous capture
findings.change: Assign acquisition sample indices before callback queue admission, retain odd components until a complete pair, count rejected complete samples, and return only contiguous transfer ranges with gap/discontinuity clocks. Preserve loss counters through stop/restart. HackRF empty reads yield after 200 ms.
findings.original_repair_gate: Maintain acquisition sample indices/drop counters at the callback boundary, preserve complete sample pairs, and mark a new discontinuity/gap after loss. Require downstream recording completeness and DSP resets to agree with injected callback overflow.

findings.title: Soapy timeout is treated as a fatal driver failure on its first occurrence
findings.change: Classify Soapy -1/zero as bounded retry, -4 as an unknown acquisition gap requiring a new epoch, and other negative codes as terminal errors. Each native read has a 200 ms deadline and returns to ingestion controls/shutdown. Decode native-endian CS16 and reject oversized driver counts.
findings.original_repair_gate: Handle documented timeout/overflow/error codes separately with bounded cancellation-aware retries and explicit discontinuity policy. Inject -1, -4 and real errors through the backend seam and verify connection, clocks and shutdown.

findings.title: Daemon RTL gain control reports success without checking the hardware result
findings.change: Propagate RTL gain-mode/gain errors at startup and during live control. Use supported gain steps without a sentinel. Publish selected gain, original requested gain, and automatic/manual mode separately. Match GUI acknowledgements against the original request while displaying the selected step.
findings.original_repair_gate: Propagate setter errors, expose actual selected gain/mode, and keep requested/applied states separate. Test unsupported steps, zero/auto semantics and failed mode/gain calls during both startup and live changes.

findings.title: rtl_tcp gain is a successful no-op
findings.change: Send rtl_tcp tuner mode 0x03 and tenths-dB gain 0x04 at startup and during live changes. Validate controls and update cached state only after socket writes. Document that rtl_tcp has no hardware readback/acknowledgement; keep headerless metadata semantics separate.
findings.original_repair_gate: Implement the supported rtl_tcp gain mode/value commands with clear lack-of-readback semantics, or reject unsupported gain control. Verify exact wire commands and server behavior with an independent rtl_tcp endpoint.

findings.title: Daemon narrowband listening uses a wide fixed channel without mode-specific RF selection
findings.change: Prepared shared audio-rate conversion for daemon use without changing existing converter arithmetic, plus a bounded linear-phase FFT RF selector with passing production-clock/strong-neighbor tests. Protocol and AudioPipeline integration remain pending; the finding stays open.
findings.original_repair_gate: Separate RF passband width, channel sample rate and audio output rate in the protocol. Apply mode-specific complex channel selection before AM/FM detection, and measure squelch on that selected signal. Test desired/adjacent mixtures at realistic amplitude ratios.

findings.title: Scanning can wait forever on a frequency a fixed replay capture cannot contain
findings.change: Validate complete fixed-file scan grids and mode-profile bookmark passbands against the same exact, sided VFO limits used by tuning. Reject unsupported scans with an explicit frequency/available-range result before tuning or consuming observations. Revalidate source and geometry changes, select bookmark mode before tuning, and retain all freshness/settle guards.
regressions: Five new replay_scan regressions: 32 edge tunes; range/bookmark rejection; actual Auto grid boundaries; sample-rate/decimation/bandwidth/center and source transitions; unchanged replay position/epoch and no cached hits after rejection.

All 26 scanner, 23 radio_ui and 31 sdr_panel tests pass. GUI default build, all-target Clippy, formatting and AST graph refresh pass under a strict 20%-of-one-CPU quota. See repair-scan-verification.json.
findings.original_repair_gate: Validate scan geometry against fixed capture bounds before starting or skip unavailable bookmarks with an explicit result. Test out-of-span, edge-passband and source-transition cases while preserving fresh-measurement requirements.

findings.title: IQ-only recording does not finish when the capture session ends
findings.change: Bind pre-armed recorders to their first session, drain EOF without waiting for another block, and finalize before a replacement session. Propagate source-end metadata to the UI finalizer.
findings.original_repair_gate: On an ended owning session, drain the accepted prefix and finalize with a source-end reason without waiting for another sample. Test finite EOF, read failure, manual source stop, same-geometry restart and empty sessions independently of WAV recording.

findings.title: Read cancellation and timed-out hardware commands lack a terminal contract
findings.change: Cancel expired queued commands atomically before device setters, with correlated queued/applying/applied/rejected/cancelled receipts. Report an already-started operation as pending with its eventual outcome rather than cancelled. Use shared RTL read_async pumps for daemon and local GUI, bounded 200 ms callback reads, repeated startup-safe cancel_async and join-before-close ownership. Pause/join before live RTL setters, discard old queued geometry, retain acquisition clocks/drop indices, and bound TCP live reads/writes while preserving fragmented pairs.
findings.original_repair_gate: Use a cancellable bounded read contract and correlate command lifecycle through queued/applied/rejected/cancelled states. Ensure shutdown/control latency is bounded even when the driver keeps reporting streaming without data. Test late acknowledgements and avoid releasing hardware ownership before the read actually ends.

off_air_reference_captures: User has no current private recordings. Public Meteor-M2-4 IQ and corrected CADUs downloaded; 72k carrier slice and full corrected-CADU images compared independently. Complete RF pass and interleaved 80k mission-profile evidence remain pending.
release_gates: Keep all field/capture/hardware/audio/disk requirements from REPORT.md. Synthetic tests do not certify them.
